scope: Publication-status check for all 12 current references, followed by a bounded search for relevant published foundations.
method: Read current official arXiv abstract/version metadata for all nine cited preprints and searched the journal-reference fields.
Ran exact-title or distinctive-title web searches.
Ran publisher/venue-restricted searches across ACM, IEEE, Springer, USENIX, OpenReview, PMLR and NDSS for the recent titles.

Used author-hosted published articles, an official institutional publication record, the ACM SIGOPS proceedings page, Springer and the official Lean citation guidance to confirm candidate publications.
limits: No result means no publication version was verified in these searches, not proof that no acceptance or differently titled version exists.
ArXiv metadata may lag acceptance; some pages are cached.
Direct ACM Digital Library fetch returned HTTP 403 for Chandy-Lamport; its publication was confirmed from the author-hosted published article.
An arXiv DOI or a Zenodo software DOI does not establish conference/journal publication. Search-engine date labels and indexing categories are not publication evidence.

additional_published_candidates.title: The Protection of Information in Computer Systems
additional_published_candidates.relevance: Complete mediation includes initialization, recovery, shutdown and maintenance; cached checks must respond to authority changes. Direct grounding for the exclusive-mediated-path premise.
additional_published_candidates.placement_recommendation: Trusted-service assumptions or short foundational related-work paragraph.
additional_published_candidates.limit: A design principle, not a proof that this deployment mediates all effect-capable paths.

additional_published_candidates.title: Termination detection for diffusing computations
additional_published_candidates.relevance: Message/signal accounting detects termination of a diffusing computation. Direct foundation for treating outstanding work as part of drainage rather than equating local inactivity with completion.
additional_published_candidates.placement_recommendation: Related work near Chandy-Lamport and discussion of fence versus drain.
additional_published_candidates.limit: The archived manuscript is dated 1979; the verified journal publication is 1980. Its computation and communication assumptions are not a payment-processor coverage proof.

additional_published_candidates.title: Enforceable Security Policies
additional_published_candidates.venue: ACM Transactions on Information and System Security
additional_published_candidates.relevance: Characterizes policies enforceable by execution monitoring and uses security automata. Foundation for the scope and limits of a trusted gate.
additional_published_candidates.placement_recommendation: A concise foundation for the enforcement model; secondary priority to complete mediation and drainage.
additional_published_candidates.limit: Execution monitoring does not establish truthful reporting or completeness of an externally supplied observation interface.

additional_published_candidates.title: Implementing Linearizability at Large Scale and Low Latency
additional_published_candidates.venue: 25th ACM Symposium on Operating Systems Principles (SOSP)
additional_published_candidates.relevance: Durable completion records atomic with effects, duplicate detection, retry routing and safe metadata reclamation; addresses crash/retry behavior directly.
additional_published_candidates.placement_recommendation: Short recovery comparison; cite only if the text discusses these mechanisms.
additional_published_candidates.limit: Exactly-once behavior for its participating RPC system is not exact epoch accounting across arbitrary payment providers. The paper explicitly retains detectable ambiguity in some lease-expiry cases.

additional_published_candidates.title: The Lean 4 Theorem Prover and Programming Language
additional_published_candidates.relevance: The official published system citation for the proof assistant actually used.
additional_published_candidates.placement_recommendation: First substantive mention of Lean in the method; methodological citation rather than competing security result.
additional_published_candidates.limit: Citing the tool does not validate the model-to-deployment assumptions.

recommendation: Prioritize Saltzer-Schroeder, Dijkstra-Scholten and Lean 4. Use Schneider and RIFL where their specific enforcement and recovery mechanisms are discussed. Retain closest recent preprints for fair novelty comparisons; do not add references merely for venue prestige.
changes: Saved publication-status report and separate candidate BibTeX. No existing reference was promoted to a conference/journal citation. Manuscripts, PDFs, proof/code files, results, and release candidate are unchanged. Nothing published.
